title: Snarl knife
paint:
The rip-saw's little brother, for one hand: a short chain-toothed knife with a pull-cord engine on the guard. Pose: on the 45 degree diagonal, handle bottom-left, point top-right, filling about 80% of the diagonal. Silhouette: a short bar of chain teeth, a fist-sized welded engine at the guard with a pull-cord ring and a stub exhaust, a nail-studded grip. Materials: rust, scorched steel, welds. Accent: dirty ochre daubs, soot.
At 32 px: chain teeth and an engine lump at the guard, not a plain knife.
